caseNameFull: Kugler, Attorney General of New Jersey v. Helfant and Helfant v. Kugler, Attorney General of New Jersey

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Motion to strike certain portions of petition in No. 74-80 and answer to the cross-petition in No. 74-277 denied. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.

Reported below: 500 F. 2d 1188.
